method: Read-only PIL/numpy alpha and straight-corridor analysis; no image modification.
reviewNotes: Grid analysis searches full-sheet alpha>8-free straight cuts within 20% of nominal 4x5 pitch with two clear pixels on each side. It does not certify the requested 16px alpha-zero corridors.
Failure to find a common cut does not prove touching silhouettes. Those sheets need explicit reviewed row/component ownership.
Unused-cell alpha totals are available only where cuts succeeded. Alpha1..8 remnants are preserved and are not automatically treated as visible VFX.
Opaque bounds include solid weapons/accessories; they are not an anatomical body-size measurement.
Candidate visual review is not runtime approval, directional animation validation, or proof of pixel-perfect pose correspondence.
